description: Fair and equitable education funding is essential to Ohio’s future, yet the current system places too much strain on homeowners while leaving rural schools underfunded. Education should never depend on the value of nearby property. When local property taxes drive school budgets, wealthier districts gain better facilities and resources, while rural and low-income communities struggle…
title: Fair School Funding Without Property Tax Burdens Can Unite and Strengthen Ohio – Godwin for Ohio
